_readme: Hand-curated, not archive-mined: the paradigm's proof case (fractal_operational_core.md, 'The immune system is the proof case') entering the app at the cell rung, written 2026-09-10. Container here means PART OF — the thymus and the two cell kinds sit inside the immune system on the same rung, not on the rung above it.

grounding.note: Written by hand 2026-09-10 from fractal_operational_core.md 'The immune system is the proof case'.

entities.name: The immune system
entities.note: The entity that draws self against non-self, values threats, and remembers shapes — the three acts in a body.

postures.name: Vaccination — an engineered analogical intervention: a harmless structural cousin shown so the real thing is recognised later.
postures.source: fractal_operational_core.md §5 — The immune system is the proof case
postures.falsifier: A vaccine that protects with no structural likeness to the pathogen would break this.

entities.name: The thymus
entities.note: Where the body teaches its cells which shapes are self; failure here is autoimmunity — a boundary drawn wrong at the cell rung.

entities.name: The regulatory T cell
entities.note: The part whose job is restraint: it stops the body attacking itself. Its absence is the purge turned inward.

entities.name: The memory B cell
entities.note: Recognition of a pathogen never met, by its likeness to one already met — the analogical layer as tissue.
